scenicChapters.title: Montenegro Durmitor Ring
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Montenegro Durmitor Ring, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
